# Team Billing Subsystem — Work Breakdown

**Top deliverable:** 1.0 Team Billing Subsystem

## 100% rule check — explicit gap

**1.6 Multi-Currency Support — OUT OF SCOPE this release.** Deferred to a later release per leadership decision. Since this hasn't been documented anywhere, put it in writing now (release notes, roadmap, or the epic description) so no one on the team assumes it's implicit in any of the five pieces below. Each piece's dictionary entry below explicitly excludes multi-currency work to keep this boundary airtight.

## One boundary needs your confirmation before assignment

The five pieces you named don't say who owns *executing* a charge against a stored payment method (calling the payment gateway) versus who owns *calculating* the charge amount and *storing* the payment method. I've drawn the boundary below (Vault owns gateway execution, Engine owns calculation and orchestration) — confirm this is right before people start, since it changes what "done" looks like for both owners.

---

### 1.1 Billing Engine
- **Scope:** Calculates charges for a billing period based on usage data and pricing rules; orchestrates the charge lifecycle (determine amount → request execution from Vault → record result).
- **In:** Rate/plan logic, proration, discounts, tax calculation (single-currency), charge orchestration.
- **Out:** Storing/tokenizing payment methods (1.2), formatting/rendering invoices (1.3), collecting raw usage events (1.4), any UI (1.5), multi-currency conversion (1.6 — deferred).
- **Deliverable:** A service that produces a finalized charge record per customer per billing period.
- **Interfaces:** Consumes usage data from 1.4; requests charge execution from 1.2; publishes finalized charges to 1.3 and 1.5.
- **Acceptance:** Given known usage + pricing inputs, produces charge amounts matching expected test fixtures; charge orchestration correctly records success/failure from the Vault.
- **Size:** TBD — owning engineer to size at sprint planning.
- **Owner:** TBD.
- **Dependencies:** Needs usage data contract from 1.4 and execution interface from 1.2 defined before it can be fully built/tested.

### 1.2 Payment-Method Vault
- **Scope:** Securely stores, tokenizes, and manages customer payment methods; executes charge requests against the payment gateway on behalf of the Billing Engine.
- **In:** Add/update/delete payment methods, tokenization, PCI-relevant handling, gateway integration, charge execution API.
- **Out:** Deciding *how much* to charge (1.1), invoice formatting (1.3), usage collection (1.4), UI (1.5), multi-currency payment methods (1.6 — deferred).
- **Deliverable:** A service with an API to manage payment methods and execute charges.
- **Interfaces:** Exposes charge-execution API to 1.1; exposes payment-method-management API to 1.5 (for admin view, if applicable) or a future customer-facing surface.
- **Acceptance:** Payment methods can be added/removed/tokenized; a charge-execution call returns success/failure/error states correctly against a test gateway.
- **Size:** TBD — owning engineer to size at sprint planning.
- **Owner:** TBD.
- **Dependencies:** None upstream; 1.1 depends on this.

### 1.3 Invoice Generator
- **Scope:** Formats finalized charge data into invoice documents and manages invoice lifecycle (draft, finalized, sent).
- **In:** Invoice document generation, line-item formatting, invoice numbering/status, single-currency presentation.
- **Out:** Calculating charge amounts (1.1), payment method handling (1.2), usage collection (1.4), UI/dashboard (1.5), multi-currency formatting (1.6 — deferred).
- **Deliverable:** Generated invoice records/documents per finalized charge.
- **Interfaces:** Consumes finalized charges from 1.1; exposes invoice data to 1.5.
- **Acceptance:** Given a finalized charge record, produces a correctly formatted invoice with accurate line items and totals.
- **Size:** TBD — owning engineer to size at sprint planning.
- **Owner:** TBD.
- **Dependencies:** Needs finalized charge data contract from 1.1.

### 1.4 Usage-Tracking Service
- **Scope:** Collects, aggregates, and stores raw usage events per customer for billing purposes.
- **In:** Event ingestion, aggregation, storage, exposing usage totals by billing period.
- **Out:** Any charge calculation (1.1), payment handling (1.2), invoicing (1.3), UI (1.5).
- **Deliverable:** A usage data store with an API returning aggregated usage per customer per period.
- **Interfaces:** Provides usage data to 1.1; may provide raw/aggregated data to 1.5 for admin visibility.
- **Acceptance:** Ingested events are correctly aggregated and retrievable by customer and billing period, matching test fixtures.
- **Size:** TBD — owning engineer to size at sprint planning.
- **Owner:** TBD.
- **Dependencies:** None upstream; 1.1 depends on this.

### 1.5 Admin Dashboard
- **Scope:** Read-only UI for internal/admin users to view bills, invoices, and related billing data.
- **In:** Viewing invoices, charges, and usage summaries; search/filter by customer or period.
- **Out:** Any calculation logic (1.1), payment method storage/execution (1.2), invoice generation logic (1.3), usage collection logic (1.4), any write/edit actions beyond viewing, multi-currency display (1.6 — deferred).
- **Deliverable:** A UI surface displaying billing data pulled from 1.1/1.3/1.4.
- **Interfaces:** Read-only consumer of data from 1.1, 1.3, and 1.4.
- **Acceptance:** Admin can view a customer's invoices, charge history, and usage for a given period, matching underlying service data.
- **Size:** TBD — owning engineer to size at sprint planning.
- **Owner:** TBD.
- **Dependencies:** Needs stable read APIs/data contracts from 1.1, 1.3, 1.4 — likely the last piece to fully build out.

---

**No overlaps, no gaps:** every piece of the five sums to the subsystem scope; 1.6 documents what's intentionally excluded. Fill in Owner/Size once you assign people — I didn't invent estimates since I don't have your team's velocity or capacity data.
